notes: jam-actions-v1, 12 families. Inherits the acoustic-sft shape that trained cleanly on an L40S: 1x8 batch, bf16 LoRA r=16, cosine, seed 13. Two deliberate differences. epochs 3 not 5, because v0 saturated at epoch 3 and epochs 4-5 bought nothing -- measured, see experiments/acoustic-sft/RESULTS.md. And max_seq_len stays 16384 pending the dry-run: v1 traces are shorter than v0's but carry the same 54-tool catalog, which alone is ~13k tokens, so the catalog dominates either way. Confirm with --dry-run on the pod before training; the trainer refuses to truncate.
known_limitation: catalog (3 records) and server (1) are train-only: they have no song_id, and the split is by song, so 4 of 305 records are trained on and never scored. Excluded from any per-family claim.
